title: SDSS9 color
credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service

geometryEvidence.reference: A picture of the sky: the plane is the picture's own tangent plane, perpendicular to the sight line through the picture's centre, so it faces the Sun. That centre is 0.0 arcsec from the nebula's position, which is the whole of the recipe's inclination. Not a measured orientation of the nebula.

registration.method: The cutout's registration is its request: a tangent projection centred on the nebula's central star, north up.

displayModel: The picture lies on one flat plane facing the Sun at the nebula's distance. Nothing in the picture has depth: seen from the side it is a line.
coverage: The published frame inside a circle: the picture fades out between 70% and 98% of half its short side, so its corners are not drawn and no straight edge shows. Its stars are removed before the bake by NOX, which predicts the light under a star and does not measure it.

acquisition.operation: Request the cutout from the CDS hips2fits service: 2000 x 2000 px, 0.12 degrees wide, tangent projection on 168.698802, +55.019028, north up; no crop or resample.
